blocks.text: On the Policy Settings page, admins can control policy enforcement settings at a global level.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Policy Settings.

Click Allow for Default Resource Policy Rule. This rule is what the system defaults to if other policies don’t apply to the traffic observed. The scope of this policy acts as a catch-all for the entirety of your organization's traffic.

blocks.text: You are prompted to confirm policy settings before they take effect.
